# CircularInfoGraphic

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCircularInfoGraphic` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCircularInfoGraphic.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCircularInfoGraphic.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCircularInfoGraphic.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Angle / radius space: polar series, radial bars, activity rings, ringed infographic

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCircularInfoGraphic> CreateCircularInfoGraphic( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCircularInfoGraphic> CreateCircularInfoGraphicFromGroups( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<std::pair<std::string, double>>>>& groupedData);   // Convenience: one ring per group, one cell per (label, value) pair.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCircularInfoGraphic(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onCellClick` | `std::function<void(size_t ringIndex, size_t cellIndex)> onCellClick` | _Cell click_ |
| `onCellHover` | `std::function<void(size_t ringIndex, size_t cellIndex)> onCellHover` | _Cell hover_ |
| `customTooltipGenerator` | `std::function<std::string(const CircularCell&)> customTooltipGenerator` | _Custom tooltip generator_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `CircularTextStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Horizontal` | Upright text centred in the cell |
| `Circular` | Text follows the ring, glyph by glyph |
| `Radial` | Text runs along the radius, flipped on the left half |
| `StarStyle` | Text parked outside the chart with a leader line |

### enum `ValueVisualizationType`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoVisualization` | (not NoValue: X11's Xutil.h defines that too) |
| `Bars` | Radial bar filling the cell from its inner edge |
| `CircularLine` | Polyline across the ring linking each cell's value |
| `CircularBar` | Angular progress arc drawn across the cell |

### enum `DecorativeRingType`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoRing` |  |
| `ColorHighlight` | Solid ring stroked at the band's mid radius |
| `Graphics` | Repeated image marks around the band |
| `Pattern` | Repeating tick pattern |
| `Gradient` | Radial colour ramp across the band |

### enum `ConnectionLineType`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLine` |  |
| `InsideCenter` | Routed through the middle of the chart |
| `OutsideRing` | Routed around the outside of the outermost ring |
| `DirectCurve` | Gently bowed curve straight between the two cells |
